## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a scalable, secure, multi‑tenant ML platform across regions with proper isolation, cross‑tenant access, and cost governance. It also probes practical use of Private Link, Lighthouse, policy guardrails, and IaC pipelines.

## Key Concepts
- Azure API Management as a centralized gateway with per‑tenant routing
- Private Link to ADLS Gen2 containers and Azure ML endpoints
- Azure Lighthouse for cross‑tenant access control
- Multi‑region traffic routing via Front Door / Traffic Manager
- Terraform CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Azure Policy + Cost Management

## Code Example
```javascript
resource "azurerm_private_endpoint" "pe_storage" {
  name                = "pe-storage-tenantA"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.rg.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.rg.name
  subnet_id           = azurerm_subnet.pe_subnet.id
  private_service_connection {
    name                           = "storage"
    is_required                    = true
    private_connection_resource_id = azurerm_storage_account.tenantA.id
    subresource_names              = ["blob"]
  }
}
```

```javascript
resource "azurerm_lighthouse_definition" "example" {
  name = "cross-tenant-landing-zone"
  authorizations {
    principal_id = "<service-principal-id>"
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test tenant isolation and cost governance at scale?
- What failure scenarios require retry/backoff and how would you monitor them?

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates your ability to design enterprise-grade Azure architectures that address disaster recovery, data sovereignty, network security, and multi-tenant management requirements.

## Key Concepts
- Disaster recovery planning with RPO/RTO objectives
- Geo-redundant storage and region-pair failover strategies
- Azure Private Link and Private Endpoints for secure connectivity
- Azure Lighthouse for cross-tenant governance
- Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Cost management through automated budget alerts

## Code Example
```hcl
# Terraform configuration for two-region DR setup
provider "azurerm" {
  features {}
}

# Primary region resources with geo-redundant storage
resource "azurerm_resource_group" "primary" {
  name     = "rg-primary-eu"
  location = "West Europe"
}

resource "azurerm_storage_account" "primary" {
  name                     = "stprimaryeu"
  resource_group_name      = azurerm_resource_group.primary.name
  location                 = azurerm_resource_group.primary.location
  account_tier             = "Standard"
  account_replication_type = "GRS" # Geo-redundant storage
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you validate DR failover procedures and measure actual RPO/RTO metrics?
- What architectural modifications would be required if EU data residency mandates expansion to a third region?
- How would you implement automated testing of the DR configuration within the CI/CD pipeline?

## Why This Is Asked
This question tests ability to design a resilient Azure-based backend for a global audience with fault isolation and cost discipline. It also checks familiarity with IaC pipelines, auth integration, and cross-region considerations.

## Key Concepts
- Global routing with Front Door and TLS termination
- Cosmos DB multi-region with controlled failover
- Premium Functions for predictable perf and scale
- Caching/session state strategy
- Entra ID integration for auth
- IaC-driven CI/CD (Terraform/Bicep)
- Lightweight DR testing and monitoring

## Code Example
```terraform
resource "azurerm_cosmosdb_account" "news" {
  name                      = "newsdb"
  location                  = "West Europe"
  offer_type                = "Standard"
  kind                      = "GlobalDocumentDB"
  enable_automatic_failover = true
  locations {
    location_name     = "West Europe"
    failover_priority = 0
  }
  locations {
    location_name     = "East US"
    failover_priority = 1
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test failover and measure latency impact?
- What are the trade-offs of multi-region writes vs single-region writes with cross-region replication?
